svg.aria-label: Bar chart of phonedriver against adb at p50 on an Android emulator, up to 98 times faster. read the screen (1,000-row UI tree): 24.0 ms against 2,352.4 ms for adb, 98 times faster; screenshot: 11.6 ms against 476.3 ms for adb, 41 times faster; type 100 characters: 251.1 ms against 4,840.9 ms for adb, 19 times faster; tap and see what changed: 586.9 ms against 2,725.8 ms for adb, 4.6 times faster. phone-harness is 111, 49, 22 times slower than phonedriver on the first 3 rows and does not support tap and see what changed.
